name: DreamMaker Bath & Kitchen
description: DreamMaker Bath & Kitchen in Chester Springs plans the rooms you use every day, then builds them so the next decade feels easy.

hero.headline: Remodels you can cook and bathe in

story.heading: A remodel with a sequence
paragraphs: Kitchens fail when the plan skips how you cook. Baths fail when the tile wins and the storage loses. We start with how you live.
You will know the order of work and who to call when a question shows up at 7 a.m.
DreamMaker Bath & Kitchen serves people who live and work in Chester Springs.
You'll find the phone and the next step on this page, not buried in a menu.
Come in when you're ready. We'll make the visit straightforward.
Neighbors already know the name. The site should make the first visit easy.

items: Live through the build with a point person
experience.heading: How a visit goes

feature.heading: Chester County, start to finish
feature.text: We stay on the job after the pretty photos. Punch lists get closed. You should not hunt a sub for a missing stop.

spotlight.heading: 12 Pottstown Pike
spotlight.text: Chester Springs is the office. Come in with the rooms you cannot stand anymore.

contact.heading: Talk through the rooms
contact.sub: Call to set a design visit. Bring photos and a sense of what you will not compromise on.
